copy.copied: The text was copied. Paste it into a new GitHub issue, or send it to the Portcove team another way.
copy.failed: The text could not be copied automatically. Select and copy it below.
copy.openFailed: The form could not be opened. Your text is still here; try again or copy it.

problem.copyFailed: This report is too long for a link and could not be copied automatically. Select and copy the text below, then paste it into a new bug report on GitHub.
problem.description: This is everything that will go into a GitHub bug report. Nothing is sent until you choose how to send it: from your GitHub account if you're signed in, on GitHub, or as copied text. Folder paths and your user name are replaced.

problem.title: Report a problem
